Container.Name: actual-dashboard
Container.Overview: Financial dashboard syncing data from Actual Budget into PostgreSQL, with AI-generated insights and PDF email reports.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the dashboard.

Config.Name: Appdata Path
Config.Description: Host path for the Actual Budget sync cache, and where the household config file goes if you use the file option below. Change the left side only.

Config.Name: Household Config (JSON)
Config.Description: Your household config as one line of JSON — account names, category skip lists, net worth groups. Use this OR the file path below. Leave both empty and the dashboard silently runs on placeholder names, so every filter and net worth group matches nothing real. See config/dashboard.example.json for the shape.

Config.Name: Household Config (file path)
Config.Description: Alternative to the JSON above: path inside the container to your config file. Put the file in the Appdata Path above and set this to /data/config.json.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Use the actual-dashboard-db container name as the host. Masked because it carries the database password.

Config.Name: Actual Budget Server URL
Config.Description: URL of your self-hosted Actual Budget server, e.g. http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:5006

Config.Name: Actual Budget Password
Config.Description: Password for your Actual Budget server.

Config.Name: Actual Budget Sync ID
Config.Description: UUID of the budget file to sync. Masked: it identifies your budget file on the Actual server.

Config.Name: Site Password
Config.Description: Password to log in to the dashboard.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables AI-generated monthly insights.

Config.Name: Spotlight Categories
Config.Description: Exactly 3 comma-separated category names to show as spotlight cards.

Config.Name: Browserless URL
Config.Description: Internal URL of the browserless container for PDF rendering.

Config.Name: Browserless Token
Config.Description: Shared secret token for the browserless container. Must match the token set on actual-dashboard-browserless.

Config.Name: PDF Render Base URL
Config.Description: URL browserless uses to fetch the dashboard. Use the container name.

Config.Name: PDF Render Auth Token
Config.Description: Secret that lets the headless browser read the dashboard without logging in. Required for PDF and email. Use a long random string — anyone holding it can read your dashboard.

Config.Name: Resend API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Resend API key for outbound email reports and sync alerts.

Config.Name: Email From
Config.Description: Verified sender address, e.g. dashboard@yourdomain.com

Config.Name: Email Recipients
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of recipient email addresses.

Config.Name: Sync Cron
Config.Description: Cron expression for automatic syncs, e.g. '0 */6 * * *' for every 6 hours. Empty disables.

Config.Name: Email Cron
Config.Description: Cron expression for monthly email report, e.g. '0 8 1 * *' for 1st of month at 8am. Empty disables.

Config.Name: Cron Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for all cron schedules.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy
Config.Description: Set only when a reverse proxy in front of the dashboard rewrites X-Forwarded-For. Leave empty when nothing fronts it: the header is then ignored, so a client cannot spoof it to get past login rate limiting.
